arabic text:
AY NANA TERI UMMAT SE TERE DEEN BACHA KAR LAYI
HAI (TERI BEGHAR ZAINAB AYI HAI)
(HO TERI BEGHAR ZAINAB AYI HAI) BECHADAR ZAINAB
AYI HAI
TERA DEEN BACHA KAR LAYI HAI
english translation text:
O Grandfather, I have saved your religion from your own community.
(Your homeless Zainab has returned.)
(Your homeless Zainab has returned.)
Your unveiled Zainab has returned,
having preserved your faith.

arabic text:
(PUCHA JO KISI NE ZAINAB SE BHAYI HAI KAHA TO
ZAINAB NE) (EK MUTHI KHAAK UTHAYI HAI) AUR
KHAAK HAWAA ME URAAYI HAI
TERI BEGHAR ZAINAB AYI HAI
english translation text:
When someone asked Zainab, ‘Where is your brother?’
she lifted a handful of dust
and scattered it into the air.
Your homeless Zainab has returned.

arabic text:
(QURAN THA JO SHABBIR KA TAN MAKTAL MEI SUMO
SE RONDHA GAYA) (JUZDAAN THA JO TAN KA KURTA)
WO KHUN ME DUBAA LAYI HAI
TERI BEGHAR ZAINAB AYI HAI
english translation text:
Shabbir’s body was the Qur’an, trampled in the battlefield.
His blood-soaked shirt was its cover;
I have brought it back immersed in blood.
Your homeless Zainab has returned.

arabic text:
(BE JAAN HUJRE CHUP DARWAAZE SABIT PARDE PE
JUMBISH LAB) (YAA GHAR ME HAI EK SANNATA) YA
ZAINAB KI THANHAAYI HAI
TERI BEGHAR ZAINAB AYI HAI
english translation text:
The lifeless rooms and closed doors are silent; not even a curtain moves.
Either the entire house is silent,
or this is Zainab’s loneliness.
Your homeless Zainab has returned.

arabic text:
(MAQTAL MEI LAGI THI KIMAT-E-DEEN BOLI DETE
THE DUSHMAN-E-DEEN) (AY NANA ME NE KIMAT DI)
APNI CHADAR SE CHUKAAYI HAI
TERI BEGHAR ZAINAB AYI HAI
english translation text:
In the battlefield, the enemies of faith demanded the price of religion.
O Grandfather, I paid that price
with my own veil.
Your homeless Zainab has returned.

arabic text:
(THA JISNE SAWAAR KARAYA JAB ZAINAB KI SAWARI
NIKLI THI) (EY SHEHR-E-MADINA KAHA HAI WO)
ZAINAB KI SAWARI AYI HAI
TERI BEGHAR ZAINAB AYI HAI
english translation text:
The one who once helped Zainab mount her camel—where is he now?
O city of Madina, look:
Zainab’s caravan has returned.
Your homeless Zainab has returned.
